evidence: Bounded first-write window capture in synthetic Windows/Wine fixtures
checks: Reads fault-address bytes before the trapped write retries.
Reads native stack at captured RSP.
Unreadable private-page window remains invalid and zero-filled.
Rejects excessive window count, null specs, oversized read and out-of-range offset.
Private and WRITECOPY image restoration, cancellation, foreign faults and concurrent writes remain covered.
limitations: Windows are sequential reads, not atomic against other threads.
Concurrent cancellation and OS read/protection failures are not exhaustively injected.
Synthetic register-source coverage directly checks fault address and RSP; RBP/RBX publication windows require live validation.
